about.label: About
about.title: Behind the viewfinder
about.body: I'm Alex Vicente and I take photographs as a hobby. I enjoy finding something worth keeping on a trip, a walk or in an everyday scene.
about.body2: raw.vives is my space to share those images and keep learning. I don't need every photograph to be perfect; I enjoy the journey to finding it.

faq.title: Before writing.
faq.description: A few notes about this archive and sharing its photographs.

items.q: Can I use a photograph from the archive?
items.a: Yes, with a prior license. Write to me with the photo and the intended use (commercial, editorial or personal) and I will propose terms.

items.q: How do I request a license?
items.a: Use the Licenses tab in the form: include the photo ID or title, the type of use and a short description. The more detail, the faster the answer.

items.q: How long do you take to reply?
items.a: This is a personal project that I work on in my free time. I reply when I can; if your question has a deadline, please mention it in your message.
No. Photography is a hobby, and this archive is a way to enjoy it and share what I'm learning. If you have an idea in common, feel free to write.

items.q: Can I share a photo with credit?
items.a: For non-commercial uses with visible credit to raw.vives, write to me anyway: I usually authorize them at no cost.
